question: A person who spends 55% of his monthly income is able to save ₹6,408 per month. His monthly expenses (in ₹) are :
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Income** = 100%

**Savings** = 100% − 55% = 45%

45% ratio → ₹6,408

**Expenses** (55%) = (6,408 ÷ 45) × 55 = 1,424 × (55 ÷ 10) = 142.4 × 55 = 7,832

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,832.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Spending percentage** = 55%

**Monthly Savings** = ₹6,408

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6de00c3e9980deed3152044f0336e0dfd9a0a9c5acfab860d3fabc27807f2705.png] 

Let the **Monthly Income** be x.

⇒ **Savings percentage** = 100% − 55% = 45%

⇒ 45% of x = 6,408

⇒ (45 ÷ 100) × x = 6,408

⇒ x = (6,408 × 100) ÷ 45

⇒ x = 14,240

⇒ **Monthly Expenses** = 55% of 14,240

⇒ **Monthly Expenses** = (55 ÷ 100) × 14,240

⇒ **Monthly Expenses** = 0.55 × 14,240 = 7,832

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,832.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Formula

Total Income = Total Expenditure + Total Savings.

Percentage Change in Income

If income increases by r%, new income = Original Income × (100 + r)/100.

Savings Ratio

Savings % = (Savings ÷ Income) × 100.
